Aug. 24th Chas. P. McGinty - 26 - Epileptic of Pittsburgh, Pa. on 15th of Aug- ust met with auto accident - with fractured skull and part of the brain. He had received Holy Communion that a.m. and astonishingly never lost consciousness through a whole yr in hospital .... Is En- rolled To-day $5.
Page 296
Aug. 24th Miss MacHale - 205 Alger - Tr 2 - 6908 - wants a room in whi ...
Leroy Ensinan and Brother Roland 6 and 2 the one deaf mute, the other quite enemic. The older Br. had spinal maningitis when 8 months old. ...
26th Geo. Sharbo - 39 - drownd Aug. 19 in B. - 8 days now - left wife and daughter - body not yet found.
John Donahuehue - 13 - missing from home - left note - he was go- ing to San Fr'isco.
Grace Darca - 4 - blind for some months. Enrolled at Easter time - now see pretty well with one eye.
Cath. Morris - 33 - ostamalitis of spine ..... has husband and one child.
29th
Alice Ellenholz - 51 - baptist - cancer in shoulder glands . .... Robert and Wm. Streicher of Toledo - In doubt about vocation - 18 yrs. - on 22.
Francis Boland - 55 - intestinal cancer - had operation - fear .... 1941, September
Page 297 Sep. 3rd
Mrs. Clara Gladieux of Toledo - 63 - threatening pains in breast . ... Martin Nich - 28 - Siatic Nerve ...
Emil Peletier - 46 - Ft. Custer - accident some months ago - now mental
Mrs. Eliz. (Jos.) Schemansky - 53 - liver trouble - in fact, Drs. re- fuse to operate - has husband and three children. .. . married in rectory Our Lady of Sorrows and promising to become Catholic - i.e. to take instructions. .. has seemingly just been putting it off from day to day - from year to yr. - now 30 years. Enrolled again Today.
